s: Din chalitzat hattepillin ubo y' seipim: asur lehassiach dato mehattepillin kol zeman shehen alayv apillu rega echad, qal vachomer mitztzitz: mah tzitz sheen bo ella azkara achat — omra tora: "vehaya al mitzcho tamid", shello yassiach dato mimmennu, tepillin sheyyesh bahen azkarot harbeh — al achat kamma vekamma. Veeno niqra hessach haddaat ella kesheomed bischoq o beqallut rosh (o shemmatrid dato kol-kak letzorke haggup ad shellebabo poneh miyyirat shamayim mechamat tirdato), abal kesheomed beyira umitasseq bitzrakayv, ap-al-pi sheoseq bimlakto ubeummanuto veen dato al hattepillin mammash — en zeh niqra hessach haddaat, sheim lo ken ek yakol kol adam lelek bitpillin kol hayyom. Umikkol maqom mitzva min hammubchar shello lehassiach dato mehen kelal, zulat bishat talmud tora ubitpillat shemoneh esreh:

Chayyab adam lemashmesh battepillin bekol shaa veshaa, dehaynu bekol paam shennizkar bahem — chayyab lemashmesh bahem, sheal yede kak nizkar alehem tadir, velo yaggia lide hessach haddaat gamur. Vimashmesh beshel yad techilla veachar-kak beshel rosh, shello lehaabir al hammitzva, shehashshel yad semuka lo lemashmesho yoter mehashshel rosh. Veeno chayyab lemashmesh bahen bishat hattepilla, sheaz en lachosh sheyyabo lide hessach haddaat gamur, shehu sechoq veqallut rosh, veap al pi ken tob sheyyemashmesh bahen, kede sheyyihyeh dato alehen mammash, shezzehu mitzva min hammubchar. Uminhag yapeh lemashmesh battepillin keshemmazkir mitzvatan biqriat shema, umemashmesh beshel yad kesheomer: "uqeshartam leot al yadeka", ubeshel rosh kesheomer "vehayu letotapot ben eneka":

Keshecholetz tepillin — tzarik lachalotz shel rosh techilla, sheim yachalotz shel yad techilla — nimtzet munachat alayv tepillin shel rosh bilbaddah, vehattora omra: "vehayu letotapot ben eneka", vedareshu chakamim: kol zeman shebben eneka yihyu shettayim, shellekak neemar: "vehayu", shehu leshon rabbim, velo neemar "uqeshartam leot al yadeka uletotapot veku'":

Al pi haqqabbala tzarik lachalotz shel rosh meummad, kemo shehanachatah hi meummad, veken hakkerikot shel etzba. Abal tepillin shel yad shehanachatah hu meyushshab al pi haqqabbala — chalitzatah gam ken meyushshab. Uleminhagenu shehanachat tepillin shel yad hi gam ken meummad — (yakol) lecholtzah gam ken meummad:

Yesh mehachakamim shehayu nohagin lachalotz tepillin shel rosh beyad semol, shehi yad keha, kede leharot sheqqasha alayv chalitzatan, mippene shemmitzvatan kol hayyom, ella shemmippene sheen lanu gup naqi anu choletzin miyyad achar hattepilla:
Yesh shehayu nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lachalotz tepillin shel rosh qodem shemmesir haretzua mehaetzba. Veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lehasir haretzua miqqodem:

Keshemmeqappelan — lo yikrok haretzuot al habbattim ella al hatztzedadim (veeno domeh lemitpachat shekkorekin al hasseper tora, mippene shehammitpachat naaset shomer lasseper tora umeshammeshah elayv bikrika zo, laken en kan genay kelal lasseper tora bikrika zo, veadderabba zehu kebodah, mah sheen ken haretzuot sheenam meshammeshim kelum lehabbattim bikrika zo). Veyesh nohagin lekorkan kiknapayim, al shem kanpe yona. Ukeshekkorekan al tzidede hattepillin — tzarik leechoz hattepillin beyado veliglol haretzua alehen, velo leechoz haretzua beyado veliglol hattepillin letokah, shemmutab shettiggalel haretzua mimmah sheyyitgalelu hattepillin:

Keshemmannichan battiq — tzarik lizzaher lehannichan beinyan shekkesheyyabo littelan mishsham lelobshan lo yukal lipgoa beshel rosh techilla, kede shello yitztarek laabor al hammitzva lilbosh shel yad techilla. Velaken min harauy haya lehannichan bekis tzar vearok, shel rosh millematta vealayv shel yad, shekkesheyyabo littelan — yipga techilla beshel yad hammunnach lemala, sheen issur min haddin bemah shehashshel yad munnach al gabbe shel rosh, ap al pi shehashshel rosh qedushshato chamura mehashshel yad, hoil umikkol maqom shenehem dabar echad, shehapparashiyyot hakketubot bezeh ketubot bezeh. Ella sheap-al-pi-ken yesh shennahagu shello lehannichan bekis echad zeh al gabbe zeh, ella bishne kisin zeh etzel zeh, ella shehashshel yad yehe munnach qetzat letzad mala, sheim yihyu munnachim beshaveh — yitztarek lipamim laabor al hammitzva, dehaynu im yabo hashshel rosh mezumman lepanayv techilla neged yad yemino shennotel bah hattepillin — yitztarek laabor alayv velittol hashshel yad, abal keshehashshel yad hu qetzat letzad mala — en kan maabir al hammitzva, shehare hashshel yad samuk lo yoter. Venahagu lesammen hakkisim ezeh leshel rosh veezeh leshel yad, shekkevan shehashshel rosh qedushshato chamura — asur leshannot achar-kak hakkis shello litten bo hashshel yad, ella im ken hitna battechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer:
Keshennotel hattepillin mehattiq — lo yenaarem min hattiq, ella yittelen beyado mittoko:
Minhag chakamim lenashsheq hattepillin bishat lebishatan ubishat chalitzatan:
